시편 9:1.content: To the chief Musician upon Muth–labben, A Psalm of David. I will praise thee, O Lord, with my whole heart; I will shew forth all thy marvellous works.

시편 9:2.content: I will be glad and rejoice in thee: I will sing praise to thy name, O thou most High.

시편 9:3.content: When mine enemies are turned back, they shall fall and perish at thy presence.

시편 9:4.content: For thou hast maintained my right and my cause; thou satest in the throne judging right.

시편 9:5.content: Thou hast rebuked the heathen, thou hast destroyed the wicked, thou hast put out their name for ever and ever.

시편 9:6.content: O thou enemy, destructions are come to a perpetual end: and thou hast destroyed cities; their memorial is perished with them.

시편 9:7.content: But the Lord shall endure for ever: he hath prepared his throne for judgment.

시편 9:8.content: And he shall judge the world in righteousness, he shall minister judgment to the people in uprightness.

시편 9:9.content: The Lord also will be a refuge for the oppressed, a refuge in times of trouble.

시편 9:10.content: And they that know thy name will put their trust in thee: for thou, Lord, hast not forsaken them that seek thee.

시편 9:11.content: Sing praises to the Lord, which dwelleth in Zion: declare among the people his doings.

시편 9:12.content: When he maketh inquisition for blood, he remembereth them: he forgetteth not the cry of the humble.

시편 9:13.content: Have mercy upon me, O Lord; consider my trouble which I suffer of them that hate me, thou that liftest me up from the gates of death:

시편 9:14.content: That I may shew forth all thy praise in the gates of the daughter of Zion: I will rejoice in thy salvation.

시편 9:15.content: The heathen are sunk down in the pit that they made: in the net which they hid is their own foot taken.

시편 9:16.content: The Lord is known by the judgment which he executeth: the wicked is snared in the work of his own hands. Higgaion. Selah.

시편 9:17.content: The wicked shall be turned into hell, and all the nations that forget God.

시편 9:18.content: For the needy shall not alway be forgotten: the expectation of the poor shall not perish for ever.

시편 9:19.content: Arise, O Lord; let not man prevail: let the heathen be judged in thy sight.

시편 9:20.content: Put them in fear, O Lord: that the nations may know themselves to be but men. Selah.
